learn.title: Benefits of cloud computing and serverless
objectives: Name each cloud benefit and recognise it in a scenario.
Match Azure features to the benefit they deliver.
Explain serverless: event-driven, auto-scaling, pay per execution.
Choose between Azure Functions, Logic Apps, App Service and VMs.
concepts: High availability
The service stays up with minimal downtime. Usually stated as an SLA uptime percentage.
Scalability
Adding or removing resources to match demand: up/down (size) or out/in (count).
Elasticity
Scaling that happens automatically as demand changes.
Reliability
The ability to recover from failures and keep working, for example with zones, regions, backup and DR.
Predictability
Predictable performance (autoscale, load balancing) and predictable cost (pricing calculator, Cost Management, reservations).
Security and governance
Built-in security tools and patching, plus policies and locks that keep resources compliant.
Manageability
Management of the cloud (autoscale, templates, monitoring, alerts) and management in the cloud (portal, CLI, APIs).
Serverless
No server management. Code runs on events, scales automatically (even to zero), and you pay per execution.
Azure Functions
Serverless code triggered by HTTP, timers, queues, blobs and more.
Azure Logic Apps
Serverless, low-code workflows built in a visual designer with hundreds of connectors.
comparisons: HA = staying up. Reliability = recovering from failure.
Functions: write code. Logic Apps: design workflows visually with connectors.
Functions: event-driven, pay per execution. App Service: always-on web apps on a plan you pay for.
Consumption: scales to zero, possible cold start, time limit. Premium: pre-warmed instances, no cold start, longer runs.
traps: High availability doesn't mean zero downtime.
Predictability covers performance as well as cost.
Resource locks protect resources from changes and deletion. They don't scale or secure sign-ins.
Serverless still has servers; you just don't manage them.
Consumption-plan functions have a maximum execution time.
revision: Uptime = HA. Recover = reliability. Demand = scalability. Automatic = elasticity.
Forecast cost = pricing calculator. Track cost = Cost Management and budgets.
Rules = Azure Policy. Prevent deletion = resource locks.
Code on events = Functions. Visual workflow = Logic Apps.
Serverless containers that scale to zero = Azure Container Apps.
